verdict.rationale: IRCC is a government immigration services portal for applications, eligibility questionnaires, status checks and processing times, not a developer platform or API product. A sandbox test environment separate from production data is a category error for this kind of service. Nothing in the evidence shows IRCC offers any sandbox, test mode or developer environment that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
